semantics.snapshot_rule: Every accepted canonical tree state has an explicit immutable snapshot/release identity.
semantics.content_rule: Snapshot binds root Contract Format artifact plus accepted canonical source tree and manifests/evidence.
semantics.history_rule: Prior accepted snapshots remain traceable according to retention policy.
semantics.rollback_rule: Rollback selects an exact prior accepted snapshot; it never reconstructs state heuristically.
semantics.validation_rule: Rollback target was previously accepted or is revalidated according to explicit policy.
semantics.runtime_rule: Repository rollback and runtime reload are separate operations.
semantics.identity_rule: Rollback changes active accepted snapshot, not canonical identities inside unchanged artifacts.

invariants.rule: Candidate canonical trees become accepted/locked only through explicit reproducible validation and clean replacement; review state, acceptance state and runtime activation remain distinct.

hard_gates.condition: rollback reconstructs from newest files heuristically
root bootstrap omitted from snapshot definition
rollback silently triggers runtime without policy

references.purpose: Rollback uses the same clean replacement boundary.
